rationale: Signal Fold keeps the folded-card geometry that belongs to a collecting product, reads as a deliberate F at 32px, has the strongest continuity with the existing card and website language, and needs no new palette to stay coherent in light and dark presentation.

application_icon.note: Applied through the official Discord PATCH /applications/@me endpoint.

application_description.note: Replaced the generic platform copy with the actual free-play product description.

guild_icon.reason: The Loftwah guild icon belongs to the wider server identity and was not replaced.

server_banner.reason: The guild has no BANNER entitlement (Boost tier 2 is required). The 960x540 and 1920x1080 assets are retained for later use.

application_cover_image.note: Applied the 1920x1080 Signal Fold banner through the supported cover_image field. This is the application cover image, not the bot profile banner.

application_banner.reason: The bot profile banner is a Developer Portal surface. The bot API can update the application icon and cover image but not the profile banner; no claim is made that the old banner was replaced.

discord_setup_panel.note: Public-safe onboarding panel posted in the existing test channel. Pinning was denied because the bot lacks MANAGE_MESSAGES.

rollback.application_icon: Restore a previous application icon from the Developer Portal or PATCH /applications/@me with the archived asset.
rollback.previous_description: Foilbury is an open, customisable gachapon and digital collectibles platform. Create collections, design cards, configure rarity and pull mechanics, and discover the thrill of revealing something new.
rollback.assets: All three systems remain under public/brand/kit/systems/ and the legacy marks remain under public/brand/kit/.
